poll.source_locator: Report p.1 '2026 Senate Election': with leaners, Pappas 54, Sununu 42, Laplante (Constitution) 2, another <1, undecided 2; methodology p.10: Oct 27-31, 2,040 likely voters. Read in Max's Chrome 2026-11-02 ~08:45 PST (the PDF answers a browser; curl gets a Cloudflare 403).
poll.notes: PRIMARY VERIFIED 2026-11-02 on the UNH report PDF. The UNH report PDF https://scholars.unh.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=2010&context=survey_center_polls returned a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403) to curl and WebFetch on 2026-11-02; not bypassed. The landing page https://scholars.unh.edu/survey_center_polls/1011/ (reachable) confirms the poll and the 11-1-2026 publication but gives no numbers. Numbers, n and dates come from the Wikipedia general-election row citing that landing page, and agree with 270toWin ('Univ. of New Hampshire', 11/01/2026) and PollCheck. Integrator: verify on the PDF before ingesting, or hold. Landing-page title: 'NH Final 2026 Election Poll: Dems Lead in Federal Races, Governors Race Deadlocked 11/1/2026'. denominator_class FULL follows the prior UNH NH row; Laplante (Constitution) share not separated here.

pollster.weighting_quote: Data were weighted by respondent sex, age, education, and region of the state to targets from the most recent American Community Survey ... as well as to party registration levels provided by the NH Secretary of State and to 2024 election results in New Hampshire.
